title: Balochistan Control Of Goondas Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Control Of Goondas Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
BALOCHISTAN
CONTROL OF GOONDAS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Balochistan Control of Goondas Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 11th March, 2002]
No. Legis. 2-42/Law/79-IV,
dated 11-3-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 1st February, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Control of
Goondas (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No. Legis. 2-42/Law/79-IV,
dated 11-3-2002.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 1st February, 2002, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Ordinance XXX of 1959.--In the Balochistan Control of Goondas Ordinance,
